rule: Any runtime-interpolated string whose script or direction is not controlled by the surrounding chrome must be bidi-isolated.

mechanism.css: unicode-bidi: isolate; /* applied to the span that holds the variable */

points.example: Any input field reflecting submitted UGC back into chrome
Free-text columns embedded in otherwise-LTR chrome

anti-pattern: Relying on the browser's default bidi algorithm to handle mixed-direction runtime strings — produces directional smearing across punctuation boundaries.
